videos.title: What Was the First Alcohol?
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description:
Alcoholic drinks are nearly ubiquitous across ancient human cultures, with many independently developing them at some point in time. But which one was oldest? Let’s take a journey through the archaeology of alcohol to find the very oldest drink. 

Hosted by: Reid Reimers (he/him)

videos.title: 5 Maps That Changed History
videos.author: SciShow
videos.description: Maps are amazing tools for navigation, but that's not /all/ they are. Maps can change how we view the world, and can tell us how it /was/ viewed and what we understood at the time the map was made. Today we’re talking about 5 maps that changed history, some for the better, some… maybe up for debate.
